issues.issue: Whether the hearing should be reopened after the claim was declared abandoned (rule 55)
issues.applicant_position: Female claimant tried to change address on June 15, 2010, but was refused; communication problems caused her non-appearance.
issues.result_text: Application to reopen the hearing is dismissed.

issues.issue: Whether there was a breach of natural justice because of the claimants' failure to update their address
issues.applicant_position: Address change was refused for lack of husband's signature and lawyer's office was closed; she believed the change was made.
issues.result_text: Member followed legal procedure and natural justice; failure to update address was the claimants' responsibility.
